plugin.name: Soda Music
config.auth_notice.title: Request authentication
config.auth_notice.content: Soda endpoints may answer anonymous requests with an empty HTTP 200 response. The plugin imitates Luna PC 3.5.1 by default; if risk control keeps triggering, fill in Cookie, X-Helios and X-Medusa from requests made by the Soda PC client. Credentials are sensitive data, do not share them.

config.iid.summary: iid of the Luna PC request; must match the credentials
config.cookies.title: Cookie
config.x_helios.title: X-Helios
config.x_medusa.title: X-Medusa
